weekly_theme.summary: 水星目前正在逆行（落在天蠍座，10/24–11/13），這段時間適合放慢腳步、重新確認訊息，避免倉促簽約或做重大決定。 太陽剛進入天蠍座不久，生活重心可能悄悄轉往天蠍座相關的主題與氣氛。

aries.horoscope: 當你今天早上起牀時，你可能會發現自己的生活空間陷入混亂。將一天的時間用於整理和清潔房源的衝動可能會變得相當強烈。雖然採取行動很棒，但請記得牢記大局。白羊座，無論你今天處理甚麼任務，都要保持平衡的觀點。如果你的家不是一塵不染，宇宙就不會崩潰。
aries.horoscope_en: As you rise this morning, you may find yourself feeling that your living space is in disarray. The urge to dedicate the day to tidying and refreshing your home could become quite intense. While it's great to take action, remember to keep the bigger picture in mind. Whatever tasks you tackle today, Aries, maintain a balanced perspective. The universe won't collapse if your home isn't spotless.

taurus.horoscope: 您為職業生涯付出的努力和奉獻精神將很快產生成果。為了達到目前的位置，你付出了艱苦的努力，而你攀登成功階梯的旅程還遠未結束。你不是一個簡單地沉浸在過去的成就中的人。今天，你可能會發現自己專注於制定下一個目標的策略。金牛座，一點創造力會很好地為你服務。充分利用您所掌握的資源。
taurus.horoscope_en: The effort and dedication you've poured into your professional life are set to yield results soon. You've put in the hard work to reach your current position, and your journey up the success ladder is far from over. You're not one to simply bask in past achievements. Today, you may find yourself focused on strategizing your next objective. A dash of creativity will serve you well, Taurus. Make the most of the resources at your disposal.

gemini.horoscope: 今天你可能會聽到一位年長的紳士，他可以伸出援助之手，幫助你完成一些任務。與此同時，您的家人可能已經花了一天的時間來追求自己的利益，為您留下了一些空間。接受這項協助！此外，現在是專注於家庭預算等實用功能的好時機，因此請花點時間整理數字。
gemini.horoscope_en: You might hear from an older gentleman today, who could extend a helping hand with some tasks on your plate. Meanwhile, your family members may have taken the day to pursue their own interests, leaving you with some space. Embrace this offer of assistance! Additionally, it's a good time to focus on practicalities like your household budget, so carve out some moments to sort through the numbers.

cancer.horoscope: 今天，你可能會發現自己正在向社區中的人伸出援手。無論是駕駛鄰居出門辦事，還是協助他們做家務，你的幫助意願都會發揮作用。別忘了寵物，因為它們也可能需要您的照顧。無論您選擇如何貢獻，您都會從自己的努力中獲得樂趣，並獲得感謝。 準備迎接繁忙的一天，請放心，今晚您將進入深度睡眠。
cancer.horoscope_en: Today, you may find yourself lending a hand to those in your community. Whether it's driving neighbors to run errands or assisting with chores around their homes, your willingness to help will shine through. Don't forget about the pets, as they might also require some of your care. No matter how you choose to contribute, you'll take pleasure in your efforts and receive gratitude in return. Brace yourself for a bustling day ahead, and rest assured, you'll drift off into a deep sleep tonight.

leo.horoscope: 你的勤奮和真誠的努力最近可能促進了你的財務狀況。今天，你可能會發現自己正在考慮修改預算。雖然在此期間許多人可能傾向於冒險，但您可能會在另一個方向上擺動得太遠。獅子座，保持踏實和實用，但請記住不要過於吝嗇。為了達成目前的成功，你付出了艱苦的努力，你應該好好款待自己。
leo.horoscope_en: Your diligent and genuine efforts may have recently resulted in a boost to your finances. Today, you might find yourself contemplating a revision of your budget. While many may be inclined to take risks during this period, you could swing too far in the other direction. Stay grounded and practical, Leo, but remember not to be excessively stingy. You've put in the hard work to achieve your current success, and you deserve to treat yourself.

virgo.horoscope: 今天，你可能會發現自己站出來，為家人、子女或親人承擔你通常不會考慮的責任。你對自己珍惜的人的真誠奉獻可能會產生你想要的積極結果。這不僅會給你帶來喜悅，也會讓你所支持的人感到高興。這種滿足感不僅會讓你感到被重視，還會增強你的身體活力。
virgo.horoscope_en: Today, you might find yourself stepping up to take on responsibilities for your family, children, or loved ones that you usually wouldn't consider. Your genuine dedication to those you cherish is likely to yield the positive outcomes you desire. Not only will this bring you joy, but it will also delight those you are supporting. This sense of fulfillment will not only make you feel valued but will also enhance your physical vitality.

libra.horoscope: 根植於過去的感覺可能會導致你承擔額外的職責，特別是在家庭方面。只要您認識到自己的行為對自己和協助對象都有好處，這是完全可以接受的。你擁抱的責任可能會幫助你治癒舊傷，同時塑造你的夢想和願望。此外，如果您今天支持的人在未來為您挺身而出，請不要感到震驚。
libra.horoscope_en: Feelings rooted in your past could lead you to take on extra duties, especially when it comes to family. This is perfectly acceptable, provided you recognize that your actions benefit both you and those you assist. The responsibilities you embrace might help you heal old wounds while also shaping your dreams and aspirations. Plus, don't be shocked if those you support today stand up for you in the future.

scorpio.horoscope: 如今，你可能會發現家人或鄰居伸出援手。有些人可能擅長拉扯你的心弦，以獲得他們的方式。避免陷入內疚或負面情緒是很重要的。天蠍座，如果你覺得合適，請提供幫助，但請記住，你的意願應該源於你自己的願望，而不是義務感。這項體驗也可以揭示你對自己的寶貴見解。
scorpio.horoscope_en: Today, you might find family members or neighbors reaching out for assistance. Some may have a knack for tugging at your heartstrings to get their way. It's important to avoid falling into feelings of guilt or negativity. Offer your help if it feels right to you, Scorpio, but remember that your willingness should stem from your own desire, not a sense of obligation. This experience could also reveal valuable insights about yourself.

sagittarius.horoscope: 您今天可能會發現自己懷疑自己的技能，導致您對通常會跳過的專案或任務猶豫不決。這可能與你一直渴望探索的東西或向有需要的人伸出援手有關。保持你的自信心是至關重要的，但如果它動搖了，請提醒自己，奉獻和努力與天賦一樣重要，而且你非常願意投入工作！
sagittarius.horoscope_en: You may find yourself doubting your skills today, causing you to hesitate on a project or task you would usually jump at. This could relate to something you've been eager to explore or lending a hand to someone in need. It's crucial to keep your self-confidence intact, but if it wavers, remind yourself that dedication and effort can be just as vital as natural talent—and you're more than willing to put in the work!

capricorn.horoscope: 通過電話與遠方的朋友聊天可能會激起渴望的感覺，提醒你有多想念他們。這可能會促使你對自己的人生旅程進行一些深刻反思。你可能會發現自己在質疑自己目前正在走的道路，並探索其他可能性。作為摩羯座，你自然傾向於在做出任何承諾之前小心行事，確保你仔細權衡每一個細節。
capricorn.horoscope_en: A chat over the phone with a distant friend could stir up feelings of longing, reminding you of how much you miss them. This may prompt some deep reflection on your own life journey. You might find yourself questioning the path you're currently on and exploring alternative possibilities. As a Capricorn, you're naturally inclined to tread carefully before making any commitments, ensuring that you weigh every detail meticulously.

aquarius.horoscope: 今天，你可能會發現自己處於沉思和內省的狀態。你的想法可能包括增加收入等實際問題，也可能是關於生命意義的更深層次的存在問題。水瓶座，今天的社交互動可能對你沒有吸引力。相反，這是在家中放鬆身心的理想時機，品嚐自己的存在。在這個反思期間，參與一本好書可以提供寶貴的見解。
aquarius.horoscope_en: Today, you may find yourself in a contemplative and introspective state. Your thoughts could range from practical concerns like boosting your earnings to deeper existential questions about life's meaning. Social interactions might not appeal to you today, Aquarius. Instead, it’s an ideal time to unwind at home, savoring your own presence. Engaging with a good book could offer valuable insights during this reflective period.

pisces.horoscope: 您對朋友和社交圈的承諾可能會侵蝕您希望與伴侶分享的優質時間。由於家中有幾個人在爭奪你的時間、精力和專注力，你可能會感到有點不知所措。記住，雙魚座，你不是來為任何人服務的，除了你自己。您可以優先考慮自己的享受。隨著一天的結束，請務必為摯愛創造一些時刻。
pisces.horoscope_en: Your commitments to friends and social circles may encroach on the quality time you wish to share with your partner. With several individuals in your household vying for your time, energy, and focus, you might feel a bit overwhelmed. Remember, Pisces, you are not here to serve anyone but yourself. It's perfectly okay to prioritize your own enjoyment. Make sure to carve out some moments for your loved one as the day winds down.
